main_text.p: Sic Syr. [Syriac] Unum hinc, & alium illinc, Johan.19.18.
[Hebrew] Syr. Vetare, prohibere, inhibere: Increpare, objurgare, reprehendere.
[Hebrew] Ch. & Syr. Dolere, dolore affici. Part. [Hebrew] Dolens, ægrotus, 1. ad Cor. 12. 26. Plur. emph. [Hebrew] Infirmos, Ezech.34.4.

[Hebrew] Chald. [Hebrew] [Syriac] Syr. Dolor, morbus, ægritudo, infirmitas: Ite generaliter πάθος, Pasio, affectio, perturbatio, ad Coloss.3.5. ad Rom. 1.26. [Syriac] Dolor viscerum, i.e. Dysenteria, Act.28.8. Plur. [Hebrew] [Syriac]
[Hebrew] Syr. Justus, Rectus: Justum, Æquum. Ortum ex Hebræo [Hebrew]. Plur. [Syriac]. Scribitur etiā cum [Hebrew] in medio [Syriac], ut ad Roman. 3.4. Plur.fœm. [Syriac] Quæ justa, ad Philip.4.8.
[Syriac] Syr. Justitia, rectitudo: Item Ultio, Poena, Justitiæ exequutio. Act.28.4.
[Hebrew] Heb. Grave esse, aggravari. Aph. [Hebrew] Ch. Grave reddere, exasperare, Prov.17.25.
